title: ContHarnessInput
description: Input contract of the Cont-type analysis harness (gaps G9-G11, resolved 2026-08-23 by placing the harness BESIDE the metric registry rather than inside it). MetricSpec has no `parameters` field, TestResult has no `standard_error`, and MetricRequirements is column-oriented and cannot state 'a log whose ordering.tie_break is defined and whose l1_availability is inline' — so the harness carries its own input and output schemas and the three existing schemas are left unmodified. Reverse-generated from docs/contract/examples/ContHarnessInput.example.json and pinned to it by tests/unit/test_contract_examples.py.

event_log_ref.description: How to obtain the log. A path, a URI, or a reproduction recipe — the harness does not embed the log, because a copy of the log inside its own analysis input is a second authority on what was run.

event_log_digest.description: Contract digest of the log, canonical form 'event_log'. Optional only because a log may be regenerated rather than stored; when it is stored, omitting this makes the analysis unattributable.

event_log_header.description: The log's header, copied so that the harness input states the units and ordering guarantee it was run under. REQUIREMENTS ON IT: `l1_availability` MUST be 'inline' and the declared total order must be usable — a log declaring `t` as its total order key while admitting same-t ties is rejected, because 'consecutive book states' is undefined on it.

event_log_first_events.description: A short prefix of the log, for orientation only. Never the analysis input.
